messages:
danielle (product): Quick heads-up — coordinated SDK + docs release scheduled for today 18:00 UTC. Main user-visible changes: new config schema (RedwoodConfig), renamed `redwood.config` -> `RedwoodConfig`, and deprecation of the legacy `Client.create(...)` init path. Deprecation window: 60 days. Migration guide draft here: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4123

ryan (eng): Ack. We'll run a canary in prod tomorrow and gate with the feature flag. Any breaking calls that can be auto-mapped?

matt (eng): We can add a compatibility shim that maps the old `Client.create` signature to the new config, but it will add ~3-5ms per init and complicate type checks. Recommend shim for 2 releases then remove.

sophie (docs): I've pushed the migration guide draft and code samples in PR #4123 — python + js samples included. Please review specifically the example for streaming + new config. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4123/files

ryan (eng): Thanks @sophie. Can you add a short snippet for the minimal shim so SDK teams have an easy reference? Something like:

```python
# shim example
def legacy_client_factory(**kwargs):
    # translate old keys to RedwoodConfig fields
    cfg = RedwoodConfig.from_legacy(kwargs)
    return Client(cfg)
```

sophie (docs): Yep adding now. Also clarifying text that customers should migrate their infra-as-code templates (CloudFormation/Terraform) — the config key rename affects infra templates for private deployments.

danielle (product): Assigning comms: we'll send a short customer note tomorrow at 09:00 PT with migration timeline + support paths. @ryan @sophie confirm blockers for external announcement?

ryan (eng): No blockers. We need the SDK release artifact and a changelog entry. Matt — can you cut the release candidate after canary succeeds?

matt (eng): Yup. I'll cut a RC and post the build link. Also opening a follow-up issue to track removing shim after deprecation.

docs-bot: Published: docs PR #4123 (migration guide) — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4123 — reviewers: @sophie, @ryan

oncall-deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled: 2025-03-22T19:00:00Z, cluster: canary-east-1, rollout: 10% -> 50% -> 100% if OK

sophie (docs): Two asks: 1) someone from SDK team to sanity-check the Go idiomatic sample, 2) a short note about telemetry (no schema changes for events, only config rename) so customers know no eval regressions expected.

ryan (eng): I'll take the Go sample. Telemetry note: no event schema change, just config key rename. Add sentence in migration guide.

danielle (product): Great. Action list: (1) Ryan cut RC after canary, (2) Sophie finalize docs + add shim snippet, (3) Matt open shim-removal follow-up, (4) Comms scheduled tomorrow 09:00 PT. I'll draft customer note and drop it here for signoff.

matt (eng): Posting RC link once ready. Also adding deprecation metadata to the API registry so automated tools can warn customers.

sophie (docs): PR #4123 updated with shim snippet and telemetry note. Please take a quick pass.

ryan (eng): Reviewed. LGTM. :thumbsup:

danielle (product): Thanks everyone. If there are any late blockers DM me. We'll thread the customer note here before send.
